note: Recorded corrections for lifting Tribes: Vengeance (scripts/vengeance/lift.py). Addresses are layout (rebased) addresses.

tv_cd_dvd.exe.why: Leftover copy protection in the community no-CD executable: the entry point is ordinary MSVC start-up in .text; none of the 5,000+ relocations in .text/.rdata/.data and no .text instruction refers to these sections; no TLS callbacks; .kpjaig (808 KB, 7.81 bits/byte) has 16,328 relocations whose targets lie outside every section, as encrypted bytes do; the only pointers into it come from .bokuht, which holds the SafeDisc interface name SIntfNT.dll. The lifted copy marks both as data. A jump into them would stop at dispatch as an unpublished guest PC.

instruction_replacements.why: cmp edi, [IAT slot of Scripting.dll ?PrivateStaticClass@UVariable@@0VUClass@@A]: SRW does not lift an import as cmp's memory operand. Load the import's value (the class object's address) and set the flags with SRW's own 32-bit cmp sequence.
